data.summary:
Results-driven Operations and Asset Servicing professional with 13+ years of experience across Wells Fargo, JP Morgan, and State Street. Expertise in Asset Servicing, Corporate Actions, Custody Operations, Client Escalation Management, Transition Management, Risk & Control, Stakeholder Management, and Process Improvement. Proven track record of leading global teams, driving operational excellence, strengthening controls, and delivering high-quality service within SLA and regulatory requirements. Experienced in managing transitions, process optimization, and cross- functional collaboration across global banking environments.
Dynamic professional with over 13 years of experience in Asset Servicing, Corporate Actions, and Custody Operations leadership within the financial services industry, with expertise in process optimization, operational excellence, custodian bank client management, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration across global banking environments.
Proven expertise in driving operational efficiency, consistently delivering top-tier results through strategic planning, owning management tools/methods such as work queues, checklists, depth charts, process improvements, and cross-functional collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Skilled in resolving complex client escalations, overseeing client service operations, and implementing risk mitigation strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and meet business goals.
Demonstrated success in resource management, including talent development, allocation of financial resources, and ensuring adherence to SLAs, while fostering long-term relationships with clients and business partners.
Adept at leading change initiatives, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and maintaining high service standards to support business growth and customer retention. Expert in Investment Management, conducting in-depth financial analysis, managing asset servicing, and delivering evidence-based recommendations for investment opportunities and client acquisitions. Strong Track Record in Cross-Functional Collaboration, worked closely with internal teams, stakeholders, and clients to ensure compliance, resolve escalations, and achieve business objectives.
Migration &Transitions: Virtual and onsite Transition and process setup in India.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Wells Fargo Team Manager –WIM - Asset servicing
July 2023 – July 2025
Responsibilities:
Managed end-to-end asset servicing operations, ensuring operational excellence and adherence to SLA requirements. Oversaw corporate action events with accurate entitlement validation, reconciliation, and break resolution, and mitigating operational risk.
Handled fee setup and validation along with reconciliation and break resolution, ensuring smooth operations and reducing pricing risks.
Oversaw pricing approvals and governance, making sure processes followed company policies and regulatory standards. • Oversaw Class Action claims administration and proxy voting activities including shareholder notifications, client vote capture, and submission through proxy platforms.
Managed teams responsible for exception management, aged breaks, payment investigations, and operational controls while ensuring • SLA and TAT adherence. • Built and managed a high-performance team through mentoring, coaching, training plans, and continuous performance management. • Directing business process transitions, optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring compliance, and driving continuous improvements in




service delivery. Identifying opportunities forprocess enhancements, setting service standards, and ensuring alignment with overall company goals within the escalations function. Collaborated with senior stakeholders, operations teams, finance, and product, compliance, and business partners to improve service delivery and operational efficiency. Led two successful migrations of court accounting operations from the USA to India, ensuring smooth transitions through careful planning, clear communication, and precise execution. Established monitoring and quality control mechanisms (RCSA) to track progress, while maintaining transparent communication with stakeholders and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to optimize processes and boost efficiency.
PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE
JP Morgan Chase& Co. Team Lead – CIB - Asset servicing Responsibilities:
Sept 2020 – Mar 2023
Oversaw corporate action pricing and event setup, ensuring accuracy in entitlement validation and reconciliation. • Oversaw setup of various security types and processing of corporate actions in systems, ensuring accuracy and timely execution. • Conducted financial modeling and market research using Bloomberg, DTCC, and Bancs to validate pricing economics and client reporting. Resolve complex transaction break queries by reaching out to custodians, clients, and other departments with proper investigation. Supported NAV-related pricing activities and reporting coordination within custody operation.
• • • Managed stakeholder communication and client escalations ensuring high service standards and operational transparency. • Led transition planning and training for business process migrations, ensuring smooth execution and knowledge transfer.
State Street Corporation Senior Associate –Client Service Responsibilities:
June 2018 – Aug 2020
Managed end-to-end corporate action lifecycle for mandatory and voluntary events including dividends, bonus issues, rights, stock splits, and mergers, ensuring accurate and timely client servicing.
Acted as key contact for clients on pricing queries, entitlements, and event processing. • •
Conducted pricing validation and break resolution with custodians and fund administration teams. Performed entitlement validation, break identification, and resolution by coordinating with Prime Brokers, Custodians, Agent Banks, and Fund Administration teams to ensure seamless service delivery. Conducted security-level research using Bloomberg to validate trade economics, instrument terms, and market data for accurate client reporting and event processing. Supported onboarding of new clients and fund setups, including account configuration, data validation, reconciliation model setup, and coordination with internal teams to ensure smooth transition and operational readiness.


HDFC Bank Ltd. Assistant Manager – Banking & Finance Responsibilities:
Apr 2016 – May 2018
• Oversaw end-to-end banking operations, managing cash handling, account maintenance, and financial transaction processing. • Conducted independent KYC checks and financial investigations in compliance with RBI regulations, strengthening anti-money laundering protocols. Performed financial statement review and analysis for credit facilities and overdraft limits, assessing balance sheets, income statements, cash flows, and risk indicators. Supported credit appraisal and overdraft approvals by validating financial data, exposure limits, and compliance requirements. Enhanced compliance posture and operational resilience through proactive risk management and regulatory alignment.
Reviewed daily cash operations, reconciliations, and account maintenance with strict regulatory adherence.

•
Axis Bank Ltd. Assistant Manager – Banking & Finance Responsibilities:
Nov 2013 – Sept 2015
Managed end-to-end customer onboarding and lifecycle management, including account opening, KYC/AML compliance, product fulfillment, offboarding, and periodic customer reviews.
Managed legal documentation including EM, DCCD, and Records of Mortgage, ensuring secure, compliant, and audit-ready account

setup. Reviewed and verified financial statements for completeness, accuracy, valuation, and presentation, strengthening audit readiness and reporting integrity.
Oversaw daily banking operations including transaction processing, reconciliations, and internal audits. • Supported regulatory audits, documentation governance, and operational risk assessments.
